title: Metacore Module Contract v3 Manifest
description: Authoritative declarative grammar for a metacore addon, preset, theme or connector pack. The kernel only honours behaviour declared here; code-side discovery is never used as a side channel.

apiVersion.description: Module Contract version. Always 'asteby.com/v3' in this revision. The kernel rejects unknown values.

kind.description: Top-level shape selector. Each kind imposes additional constraints (see top-level allOf).

capabilities.description: Scoped permissions the addon requests. The host prompts the org admin for approval and the runtime enforces them by injecting a constrained AddonContext.

models.description: Data models the addon owns. The installer materialises each as a table in the addon schema (shared) or per-tenant schema, with the declared columns, indices and RLS policies.

settings.description: User-facing tenant-scoped settings the addon reads at runtime via secrets:read or the kernel settings API.

connectors.description: Third-party credential providers this addon needs. The host stores their credentials per org (encrypted); the connectors runtime resolves them for wasm handlers (connector_get) and for a webhook's secret_ref.

schedules.description: Declarative cron jobs the kernel scheduler fires per org: every 'every' it dispatches 'do'. The webhook-primary + cron-reconcile backstop.

webhooks.description: Inbound webhook routes the host mounts and the kernel webhookin receiver routes after verifying the signature against the secret resolved from secret_ref.

then.description: Addons must not declare a preset block.
Presets must declare 'preset' and must not own models or lifecycle hooks.

Metadata.description: Identity, presentation and authorship metadata for the module.

key.description: Stable lowercase identifier. Used as the addon schema name and event namespace. Immutable after first publish.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the marketplace and install UI.

version.description: Semver 2.0 version of this manifest payload. Drives the lifecycle.upgrade dispatcher.

icon.description: Triple (type, slug, color) used by the host to render the addon avatar. When type is "svg", slug is a relative path to an SVG asset bundled inside the addon (e.g. "assets/link.svg"), served by the hub under a sandboxed CSP and rendered by the frontend as an .

readme.description: Path inside the bundle to the long-form README markdown.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes the addon targets; empty = global.

i18n.description: Marketplace catalog localizations keyed by locale (es, en, ...).

Compatibility.description: Versioned dependency declarations. 'requires' replaces the v2 trio (kernel, requires, implicit host match) with a uniform list.

key.description: Dependency identifier. 'kernel' is reserved for the host. Anything else references another addon by metadata.key.

version.description: Semver range parsed by Masterminds/semver. Empty string is not allowed.

optional.description: When true, the install proceeds even if the peer is missing; the addon must gracefully detect absence at runtime.

reason.description: Human-readable justification surfaced in the install UI.

Tenancy.description: Per-tenant data isolation strategy. Defaults to shared+RLS.

isolation.description: shared: single addon schema, RLS by rls_column; schema: addon_<key>_<orgshort>; database: reserved.

rls_column.description: Column the kernel filters by when isolation=shared. Must exist on every model table the addon owns.

Capability.description: A single scoped permission grant. Wildcards in target follow shell glob semantics.

kind.description: Closed set of capability kinds the runtime enforces. `connector:read <key>` grants connector_get for one connector key: an addon implicitly reads the connectors it declares in its own `connectors` block, so this kind is what an addon uses to read a connector DECLARED BY ANOTHER ADDON (e.g. waybill-cartaporte reading fiscal_mexico's `factura_com` so the org configures the PAC credentials once).

target.description: Capability target. db:* expects 'schema.table' or 'schema.*'. http:fetch expects a URL prefix. event:* expects an event name. cron:register expects a cron expression. queue:* expects a queue name. secrets:read expects a secret key glob.

reason.description: User-facing justification for the install consent screen.

Model.description: A data model the addon owns. Materialised by the installer.

key.description: PascalCase logical identifier the SDK exposes (e.g. 'Product').

table.description: Physical SQL table name inside the addon schema.

label.description: i18n key resolving to the human label.

extensions.description: Columns this addon attaches to another addon's model. The target model must opt in via extension_points.model_extensions_accepted[].

relations.description: Inverse 1:N / N:M view edges the host projects into served TableMetadata so a detail page can list the model's child records (e.g. a Customer's vehicles, addresses, attachments). Unlike foreign_keys (physical constraints on the owning column) these are owner-rooted view hints.

seed.description: Default seed data the installer inserts on install, idempotent by a natural key column.

formulas.description: Tier-2 computed columns over the same row, evaluated before every create/update write.

locking.description: Row-locking strategy on Update. 'row' makes the kernel wrap Update in a transaction and load the target row with SELECT … FOR UPDATE before evaluating column constraints, so an increment-then-check guard is race-free. Omit for no extra locking.

sequences.description: Atomic folio counters the kernel maintains per org (or branch) for this model — invoice folios, remission numbers, tickets. A column binds to one via 'sequence' for auto-stamping on create; a wasm handler pulls one via the sequence_next host import.

stage_field.description: Column carrying the model's pipeline stage. With 'stages' it turns the model into a stage machine: the kernel derives a 'status' display for the column and validates moves + fires on_transition hooks on every Update that changes it.

stages.description: Ordered lifecycle stages of stage_field. The kernel projects them onto the column's derived status display (value/label/colour). Empty = no stage machine.

transitions.description: Whitelisted (from -> to) stage moves. An Update that moves stage_field to a pair not listed here is rejected 422 (invalid_transition). Only enforced when stages is non-empty.

on_transition.description: Bitrix-style hooks the kernel fires after a valid stage move is persisted and before the canonical event. Matched by from/to ('*' = wildcard); 'do' references a wasm:/webhook:/compiled: handler.

Seed.description: Declarative default-data block. The installer inserts rows on install, treating key as the natural key for idempotency (skip/upsert if a row with that key value already exists for the org).

key.description: The column used for idempotency — must name a declared column on the owning model.

rows.description: The default records, each an object mapping column name to value.

ModelRelation.description: An inverse 1:N / N:M edge rooted at the owning model. The host projects it into TableMetadata.relations so a detail page can list the owner's child records.

name.description: Stable identifier for the relation, scoped to the owning model (e.g. 'vehicles').

kind.description: one_to_many: foreign_key is the column on 'through' pointing back at the owner. many_to_many: 'through' is the target model joined via foreign_key.

foreign_key.description: Child column pointing back at the owner, e.g. 'customer_id'.

scope.description: Static equality filter applied to the child query. Makes polymorphic children addressable: a shared attachments table carries an 'owner_model' discriminator, so a Customer's attachments relation declares {"owner_model":"Customer"} alongside foreign_key 'owner_id'.

label.description: Optional i18n key / human label for the related-records panel.

readonly.description: When true, the related-records panel must not allow creating/editing/deleting child rows. Used for relations pointing at an append-only ledger (e.g. an inventory kardex). Pure UI metadata; defaults false.

embed.description: When true, this relation is a COMPOSITION (a document's LINES) and the record modal renders its children inline as a sub-table. Opt-in: the modal embeds ONLY relations declaring it, so a parent with a large independently-managed child collection (stock movements, transfers) stays cheap to open — those relations stay reachable from their own model page. Pure UI metadata; defaults false. Only meaningful for one_to_many.

rollups.description: Tier-1 parent-aggregate specs over this relation's child rows. Only meaningful for one_to_many.

type.description: Logical type the kernel maps to a Postgres type. Closed set kept narrow to keep cross-driver portability. Parameterized Postgres-native forms numeric(p,s), varchar(n) and vector(n) are ALSO accepted — they are a subset of what the kernel DDL plane (dynamic.ValidateColumnType / pgColumnType) materializes, so the author contract can never accept a type the engine cannot emit.

default.description: Default value as JSON literal or recognised SQL expression token (e.g. 'now()', 'gen_random_uuid()').

display.description: Optional cell renderer the SDK applies to the column's values (maps to ColumnDef.cellStyle). Pure UI metadata; ignored by the DDL plane. e.g. url, email, phone, currency, creator, status, badge, tags, color, code, percent, image, boolean, date.

widget.description: Optional FORM input the SDK renders for this column in the create/edit modal (maps to FieldDef.type/widget). DDL-agnostic input plane: a text column can declare 'image' or 'upload' so a product photo / logo / attachment renders a file picker instead of a raw text box. Other values: textarea, select, email, url, date, number, boolean, dynamic_select. Pure UI metadata; ignored by the DDL plane.

display_config.description: Renderer-specific options (maps to ColumnDef.styleConfig). Common keys: label_field, url_field, currency, decimals, base_path, new_tab, name_field, max_length. A base_path here is also projected onto ColumnDef.basePath.

tooltip.description: Path to the primary text shown on hover / secondary slot (e.g. the creator's name). Maps to ColumnDef.tooltip.

description.description: Path to a subtitle (e.g. the creator's email). Maps to ColumnDef.description.

ref.description: Foreign-key target (model key or table) the column points at. The host projects it onto ColumnDef.ref / FieldDef.ref so the SDK renders a searchable dynamic_select relation picker in the native create/edit form (resolving options against /api/options/:ref) with no per-app action. Pure UI metadata; ignored by the DDL plane.

options.description: Select choice source for the column. EITHER the STATIC array form (value/label, plus optional icon/color/image visuals → plain select) OR the DYNAMIC object form (DynamicOptions: a dependent-picker source declaration → searchable dynamic_select scoped by depends_on). Mutually exclusive. Use 'ref' for a simple relation picker, the array for a hardcoded enum, the object for a scoped/relational picker. Pure UI metadata; ignored by the DDL plane.

depends_on.description: Name of a SIBLING column whose current value supplies the cascade filter_value for this column's dependent picker (used with the 'options' object form). The host projects it onto ColumnDef.depends_on so the SDK re-fetches the options when the depended-on field changes. Empty = no cascade. Pure UI metadata.

options_source.description: DYNAMIC options provider key (e.g. 'registered_models', 'installed_addons'). Instead of a hardcoded 'options' list, the column declares WHERE its choices come from: a provider the HOST registers and resolves at metadata-serve time, materialising the localized value/label list onto the served ColumnDef.options / FieldDef.options. Open enum: the kernel only passes the key through; unknown keys simply yield no options on hosts that don't register them. Use 'ref' for a row-level relation picker, 'options' for a hardcoded enum, and 'options_source' for host-computed lists. Pure UI metadata; ignored by the DDL plane.

readonly.description: Marks a SYSTEM-GENERATED column: a value the addon/host populates server-side (e.g. an external id or number a remote API returns after a create), never something a user types. The host projects it onto ColumnDef.readonly / FieldDef.readonly so form derivation EXCLUDES the column from the create form and marks it read-only in edit; the column still renders in tables/kanban/detail. Pure UI metadata; the DDL and write planes ignore it (an addon or compute rule writes the value as usual).

scan.description: Opts the column's create/edit form input into CAMERA BARCODE SCANNING: when true and the browser supports it, the SDK shows a camera button that scans a barcode to FILL the field fast (e.g. a product SKU). The host projects it onto ColumnDef.scan / FieldDef.scan. Country/business-agnostic UI metadata; the DDL plane ignores it. Defaults false.

constraints.description: Declarative GUARD predicates the kernel evaluates inside the create/update transaction before writing. A false predicate aborts with 422 + the error_key. Combine with the owning model's locking:'row' for a race-free increment-then-check guard.

sequence.description: Binds this column to one of the owning model's sequences by key: on create, when the column is empty, the kernel stamps the next formatted folio value automatically (treated as system-generated for form derivation).

generated.description: Declares a Postgres STORED generated column: a pure arithmetic expression over OTHER columns of the SAME row (e.g. 'quantity - reserved'), emitted as `GENERATED ALWAYS AS (<expr>) STORED`. The value is maintained by the database on every write (path-independent) and is SQL-native: it filters, sorts, aggregates and exports in the database with no compute hook or wasm handler, and is excluded from INSERT/UPDATE. Expression allowlist: +-*/, parentheses, numbers, and sibling column identifiers (no self-reference). INCOMPATIBLE with default and not_null (Postgres rejects both on a generated column).

section.description: Assigns this column to a form_layout section/step by its key: the SDK places the field's input inside the matching form_layout.sections[] block (a collapsible section in mode 'sections', a wizard step in mode 'steps'). Columns without a section fall into an implicit 'General' block (or the first declared one). Pure UI metadata (maps to ColumnDef/FieldDef.section) — the DDL and write planes ignore it.

FormSection.description: One block of the model's create/edit form. In form_layout mode 'sections' it is a titled, collapsible block on a single scroll; in mode 'steps' it is one step of a wizard (the SDK validates step-by-step). Columns bind to it via column.section == this key. title/description may be a literal or an i18n key resolved by the host's localized transformer (same mechanism as column/action labels).

key.description: Stable identifier of the section/step, unique within the model. Columns reference it via column.section.

title.description: Human header for the section/step. Literal text or an i18n key (e.g. 'models.invoice.sections.identity') the host localizes at serve time.

description.description: Optional secondary text shown under the section/step title. Literal or i18n key.

collapsed.description: In mode 'sections', render the block initially collapsed. Ignored in mode 'steps'.

visible_when.description: CONDITIONAL VISIBILITY for the whole section: the SDK hides the entire block (all its fields) when the predicate is false against the live form values, using the same {field, equals?, in?} shape as a column's visible_when. Pure UI metadata.

FormLayout.description: Declarative grouping for the model's native create/edit form. Mode 'sections' renders the sections as titled, collapsible blocks on a single scroll; mode 'steps' renders them as a step-by-step wizard (validated per step by the SDK). A section and a step share the same FormSection shape. Columns assign themselves to a section/step via column.section == section.key; unassigned columns fall into an implicit 'General' block. Pure UI metadata (maps to the served form_layout) — the DDL and write planes ignore it.

mode.description: 'sections' = collapsible blocks in one scroll (default). 'steps' = wizard, one section per step.

sections.description: Ordered list of sections (mode 'sections') or steps (mode 'steps').

VisibleWhen.description: CONDITIONAL VISIBILITY for a form field in the native create/edit modal: the SDK renders the owning field only when a SIBLING field's current value matches this predicate. Pure UI metadata (maps to ColumnDef/FieldDef.visible_when) — the DDL and write planes ignore it, and a hidden field's value never gates submit. Declare EITHER 'equals' (exact string match) OR 'in' (any-of); when both are present 'in' wins.

field.description: Sibling field key whose current value drives this field's visibility (e.g. 'rule_scope').

equals.description: Show the owning field when the sibling value equals this string.

in.description: Show the owning field when the sibling value is one of these strings.

Sequence.description: One atomic folio counter the kernel maintains for the owning model, formatted through a template. Increments atomically (UPDATE … RETURNING) so concurrent creates never collide.

key.description: Sequence identifier, unique within the model (e.g. 'invoice').

scope.description: Counter partitioning: 'org' (one series per organization, the default) or 'branch' (one series per branch). Omit for org.

format.description: Template rendered around the numeric value; MUST contain exactly one {seq} or zero-padded {seq:0N} placeholder, e.g. 'A-{seq:06}' → 'A-000042'.

Constraint.description: One declarative guard predicate on a column: a boolean comparison '<arith> <op> <arith>' (op is >= <= > < == !=) over the same row's columns, evaluated before every create/update write. Each side uses the strict arithmetic allowlist, so it can never inject SQL.

error_key.description: i18n key / stable code surfaced to the client (422) when the predicate is false, e.g. 'stock.negative'.

ForeignKey.description: Cross-model reference. 'policy' selects whether the installer materialises a physical FK constraint or only validates the link in application code.

policy.description: logical: kernel enforces in application code only (safe across schemas/tenants). physical: kernel emits an SQL FK constraint.

ModelExtension.description: Columns this addon attaches to another addon's model.

target_model.description: Fully qualified '<addon_key>.<ModelKey>' of the model being extended.

Contributions.description: What this addon contributes to the host shell and to extension points published by other addons.

slots.description: Renders into a slot_kind published by another addon (or the host).

tools.description: LLM-facing actions registered into the host agent-tool registry on install.

subscriptions.description: Event handlers. Each subscription must be backed by an 'event:subscribe' capability.

dashboard.description: Widgets this addon contributes to the host's modular dashboard. Declarative kinds carry a query the host aggregates; kind 'custom' references a federated expose.

documents.description: Printable document templates this addon binds to its models. The host hydrates each bundle-relative HTML template with the record, its line-items and the org branding, then renders a per-record PDF.

config.description: The addon's configuration surface. Hosts render a 'Configure' affordance (e.g. in the installed-addons view) linking to it; addons with nothing to configure simply omit it.

key.description: Unique within the addon. The ':key' path segment of the PDF route.

model.description: The model key (own model or extended model) the document renders a record of.

template.description: Bundle-relative path to the HTML template, e.g. 'templates/remision.html'.

paper.description: Page geometry. ticket80 is an 80mm receipt roll for POS.

filename.description: Optional download filename (without .pdf), may contain {{record.<col>}} tokens.

title.description: i18n key for the widget heading.

subtitle.description: Optional i18n key shown under the title.

size.description: Grid span over a 4-column grid. Default sm.

group.description: Optional i18n key the widget is bucketed under. Default: addon name.

format.description: Applies to the scalar value and series points. Default number.

permission.description: Optional. If empty and query.model is set the host derives '<table>.index'.

empty.description: Optional i18n key for the empty state.

slot.description: Federation slot a kind:'custom' widget mounts into. Default 'dashboard.widgets'.

expose.description: Federated module name from the addon's frontend bundle (kind:'custom').

model.description: Model key of the SAME addon to aggregate over.

field.description: Column to aggregate. Required unless aggregate=count.

where.description: Filter map. Equality by default, or {op: value} where op is eq|neq|gt|gte|lt|lte|contains.

target.description: Merges into an existing host group (e.g. 'sidebar.sales').

model.description: Binds the item to a dynamic CRUD screen for that model.

filter.description: Static column→value filter the host applies when rendering this entry's list view (e.g. {"status":"reception"}), so an addon can publish one nav entry per status.

view_type.description: Renderer the SDK mounts for this entry's model: 'table' (default) or 'kanban' (a board grouped by group_by). The same model can have one table nav and one kanban nav.

group_by.description: Column the kanban board groups its columns by (typically the model's stage_field). Required when view_type is 'kanban'; ignored otherwise.

requires.description: Screen public data surface: model + actions the federated UI needs when Acceder is granted. Host projects each entry to ModelKey capability strings (Product+index → product.index), same vocabulary as dynamic tables /api/data/<Model>. Prefer this over requires_capabilities.

model.description: Manifest model key (e.g. Product, SalesOrder). Optional addon prefix (customers.SalesOrder) is stripped to the key.

actions.description: Capability suffixes: index/create/update/delete or custom action keys.

requires_capabilities.description: Flat host RBAC capability strings (escape hatch / table-path aliases). Prefer requires[{model,actions}]; the host unions both into the Acceder expand set.

Stage.description: One lifecycle stage of a model's stage_field column. The kernel projects the set onto the column's derived status display (value/label/colour), ordered by 'order'.

key.description: Stored column value for this stage (e.g. 'in_progress').

label.description: Human/i18n label rendered for the stage.

order.description: Position left-to-right on a board / in a status select.

is_final.description: Marks a terminal stage (no outgoing transitions expected).

Transition.description: One allowed move between two stages. from/to are Stage keys; a move to a (from, to) pair not present in transitions is rejected.

TransitionHook.description: A declarative side effect the kernel fires when a record transitions between stages. from/to select the matching moves ('*' matches any stage). A hook carries 'set' (assign fields on the transitioning row itself, applied before persist), 'do' (a handler dispatched as wasm:<export> | webhook:<key> | compiled:<fn>), or both.

from.description: Source stage key, or '*' to match any source.

to.description: Destination stage key, or '*' to match any destination.

set.description: Fields to assign on the transitioning row itself, applied before persist so they ride the same Save and appear in the canonical event. Scalar value = direct assignment; on a json/array column a '+tag' string appends idempotently and a '-tag' string removes. Keys must name declared columns of the model.

required.description: When true a dispatch failure rolls back the whole transition (422); otherwise the failure is logged and the transition stands.

entry.description: Bundle-relative path or federation expose pointing at the React component.

Frontend.description: The federated UI bundle the host loads at runtime for this addon.

entry.description: URL or relative path of the remoteEntry.js / bundle.

container.description: Global name the remoteEntry.js assigns itself on window.

layout.description: How the host frames the addon UI.

Action.description: A UI-triggered operation. May declare a rich declarative action modal (fields[]) and/or delegate to a custom federated modal component (modal).

connector.description: When type=connector: the connector key (declared by any installed addon) whose export to invoke, e.g. 'link'. The host resolves the owning addon and dispatches the export org-scoped.

export.description: When type=connector: the WASM export of the connector-owning addon to invoke with the action's field payload, e.g. 'link_send_message'.

placement.description: Where the host surfaces the trigger: 'row' (per-row table action, default), 'table' (page toolbar button), or 'create' (toolbar button that replaces the generic create button for a custom create experience).

fields.description: Declarative form rendered in the action modal before dispatch.

steps.description: Multi-step declarative wizard: one page per step (title + fields) with per-step validation; submits the union of all steps' values on finish. Mutually exclusive with fields.

modal.description: slot_kind of a custom federated modal component the host mounts instead of (or alongside) the declarative form.

confirm.description: Show a confirmation step before dispatch.

confirm_message.description: Body shown in the confirmation step.

requires_state.description: Gates the action on the target record's `status` column: the action is only valid when the record's status is one of these values. Enforced by the kernel at dispatch. Empty/omitted means no state gate.

modal_width.description: Explicit modal width (CSS length or px number).

idempotency.description: Makes the action replay-safe: the kernel keys a stored response by (org, model, action, payload[key_field]) and replays it on repeats without re-dispatching the handler.

key_field.description: Field in the action payload whose value is the idempotency key (e.g. a client-generated request UUID).

ActionStep.description: One page of a multi-step declarative action wizard: a title, optional description, and the fields rendered/validated on that page (same contract as Action.fields).

title.description: Step heading (or an i18n key resolving to it).

description.description: Optional helper text rendered under the title.

ActionField.description: One input in an action modal's declarative form. Mirrors the SDK ActionFieldDef.

options.description: Select choice source for the field. EITHER the STATIC array form (value/label choices → plain select) OR the DYNAMIC object form (DynamicOptions: a dependent-picker source declaration → searchable dynamic_select scoped by depends_on). Mutually exclusive.

depends_on.description: Name of ANOTHER field in the same action form (a header field or a sibling item-field) whose current value supplies this picker's cascade filter_value (used with the 'options' object form). The host projects it onto FieldDef.depends_on so the SDK scopes + re-fetches the dynamic_select options when the depended-on field changes. Empty = no cascade.

ref.description: Target model key for reference/relation fields.

scan.description: Opts this action field into CAMERA BARCODE SCANNING: the SDK shows a camera button that scans a barcode to FILL the field fast — a text/number input (e.g. a SKU) or a dynamic_select reference (scan feeds the picker's search). The host projects it onto FieldDef.scan. Country/business-agnostic UI metadata; defaults false.

options_source.description: DYNAMIC options provider key for this action field (e.g. 'connector_repos', 'installed_addons'). Instead of a hardcoded 'options' list, the field declares WHERE its choices come from: a provider the HOST registers and resolves at metadata-serve time, materialising the localized value/label list onto the served FieldDef.options. Open enum: the kernel only passes the key through; unknown keys simply yield no options on hosts that don't register them. Use 'ref' for a relation picker, 'options' for a hardcoded enum, and 'options_source' for host-computed lists. Pure UI metadata.

item_fields.description: Columns of a repeatable line-items group. Set on a field with type "array"; each entry is the cell widget for one column. The field value is an array of objects keyed by these item field keys.

lock_rows.description: Set on a type:'array' line-items field: its rows are fixed — the SDK hides add-row and delete-row controls, so the user can only edit existing rows' cells (e.g. a receive form prefilled from the ordered lines). Ignored on non-array fields.

total.description: Set on an item_fields column to sum it in the line-items footer. The SDK renders a per-column total row for every numeric column flagged with total.

accept.description: On a type:"upload" field, a comma-separated MIME / extension allow-list passed to the file picker's accept attribute, e.g. "image/*,.pdf". Ignored on non-upload fields.

max_size.description: On a type:"upload" field, the maximum accepted file size in BYTES (0 = host default). Ignored on non-upload fields.

storage_path.description: On a type:"upload" field, the logical storage bucket / path prefix the host stores the file under, e.g. "attachments/customers". Empty = host default. Ignored on non-upload fields.

label_image.description: Name of a column on the REMOTE model a dynamic_select (ref / search_endpoint) resolves against whose value (an image URL) the SDK renders as a thumbnail beside each option's label — e.g. a product photo or contact avatar. Optional; ignored on non-reference fields.

label_icon.description: Name of a column on the REMOTE model whose value (an icon identifier) the SDK renders as an icon beside each option's label. Optional; ignored on non-reference fields.

label_color.description: Name of a column on the REMOTE model whose value (a CSS colour) the SDK uses to accent each option. Optional; ignored on non-reference fields.

FieldBalanceRule.description: Optional balance constraint on a line-items (type "array") field. Declares that the sum of debit_column must equal the sum of credit_column across all rows; the SDK shows a balanced/out-of-balance indicator and blocks submit until they match. Generic — debit/credit are just the two column keys to reconcile (e.g. a journal entry's debit vs credit).

debit_column.description: Item field key whose row values sum to the left side of the balance.

credit_column.description: Item field key whose row values sum to the right side of the balance.

message.description: Optional override for the out-of-balance message shown to the user.

require_nonzero.description: When true the field is only considered balanced if the totals match AND are greater than zero (an all-zero entry is rejected). Defaults to true.

icon.description: Optional icon identifier (lucide PascalCase or simple-icons slug) the SDK renders before the option label. Pure presentation; ignored by the runtime.

color.description: Optional CSS colour (hex / token) the SDK uses for a dot / chip / text accent on the option. Pure presentation; ignored by the runtime.

image.description: Optional URL or bundle-relative path to a small image / avatar / logo the SDK renders beside the option label. Pure presentation; ignored by the runtime.

when.description: OPTIONAL static cascade guard: gates THIS option by the current value of a sibling enum field. The SDK offers the option only while the sibling's value satisfies the condition and hides the select entirely when no option applies. Only valid on the static array form of 'options'. Omitted = the option always applies (retro-compatible).

field.description: Sibling field whose current value is evaluated. Optional: when empty, falls back to the container column/field's depends_on.

in.description: The option applies when the sibling's value is one of these (string compare).

not_in.description: The option applies when the sibling's value is NOT one of these (string compare).

DynamicOptions.description: OBJECT form of a field/column 'options' block: a dependent-picker source declaration. Maps onto modelbase.FieldOptionsConfig so a dynamic_select scopes its candidates by a sibling field (depends_on) and resolves its label from a related model. Mutually exclusive with the static array form. Generic — the addon names its own tables; no domain model is baked into the kernel.

source.description: Real table the candidate rows come from (scope + computed columns). The host's OptionsConfigResolver queries it for /api/options.

filter_by.description: Column on 'source' compared to the cascade filter_value (the value of the depends_on field). Scopes the candidate list.

value.description: Column on 'source' that becomes each option's value.

label.description: Column ON 'source' used as each option's display text (and the column the 'q' typeahead + ordering match against). When empty the projection defaults to 'name'. Use it for a same-source picker labelled by a column on 'source' itself (e.g. a product picker labelled by 'name'); 'label_ref' is the cross-model twin for when the label lives on another model keyed by 'value'.

label_ref.description: Related model (key or table) whose row, looked up by the option's value (a foreign id), supplies the human-readable label. Optional: when empty the label is the value itself. The kernel batch-resolves the label in a single query (no N+1).

description.description: Column on 'source' projected onto option.description (e.g. available quantity).

FieldValidation.description: Client-side validation hints the SDK reads off the manifest-served action metadata.

connector.description: When type=connector: the connector key (declared by any installed addon) whose export to invoke, e.g. 'link'. The host resolves the owning addon and dispatches the export org-scoped.

export.description: When type=connector: the WASM export of the connector-owning addon to invoke with the action's field payload, e.g. 'link_send_message'.

event.description: Event name as published by another addon in extension_points.events[]. Must match a 'event:subscribe' capability target.

connector.description: When type=connector: the connector key (declared by any installed addon) whose export to invoke, e.g. 'link'. The host resolves the owning addon and dispatches the export org-scoped.

export.description: When type=connector: the WASM export of the connector-owning addon to invoke with the action's field payload, e.g. 'link_send_message'.

filter.description: CEL expression over the event payload; only matching events dispatch.

comment.description: Author note; ignored by the runtime.

ExtensionPoints.description: What this addon publishes for others to extend.

model_extensions_accepted.description: Names of own models that opt into accepting model extensions from other addons.

payload_schema.description: Bundle-relative path or HTTPS URL to the JSON Schema describing the payload.

Lifecycle.description: Hook map plus the upgrade ladder. The installer dispatches each entry through the addon backend runtime.

install.description: Exported function or webhook path to run on first install.

from.description: Semver range matching the previously installed version. The first matching step runs.

type.description: wasm: exported function in the addon backend. sql: goose-compatible file inside the bundle. webhook: remote HTTP.

function.description: Function symbol, file path or URL depending on type.

Rbac.description: First-class roles + permissions. Replaces the v2 legacy 'permissions' shape.

options_source.description: When type=dynamic_select: names a WASM export the host invokes to fetch options at config time. For a connector credential it runs with the org's connector context (connector_get resolves the same connector), returning {success,data:{options:[{value,label}]}}.

section.description: Binds this setting to a form_layout section (by key), like a column's section — groups a connector's credentials into its wizard steps/sections.

validation.description: Optional constraint hint (regex or named rule) the host applies when collecting the value. Used by connector credentials.

Connector.description: A third-party credential provider an addon depends on. The host collects + encrypts the credentials per org; wasm handlers read one via connector_get (gated by connector:read) and a webhook's secret_ref resolves to one.

key.description: Connector identifier (e.g. 'github'); connector_get(key) and a webhook secret_ref ('<key>.<credential>') reference it.

label.description: Human/i18n name shown in the authorization UI.

credentials.description: Fields the org supplies (access_token, repo, webhook_secret, ...). 'secret'-typed fields are stored encrypted.

form_layout.description: Groups the credentials into sections or a multi-step wizard for the config UI (same shape models use).

test_export.description: Names a WASM export the host invokes to validate the credentials (a cheap read-only call to the third-party API). Powers the config UI's 'test connection' button; returns {success,data:{ok,message}}.

Schedule.description: One declarative cron job. The scheduler parses 'every' as a Go duration and, per installed org, fires 'do' on that interval.

do.description: Handler reference dispatched on each tick: 'wasm:<export>' | 'webhook:<key>' | 'compiled:<fn>'.

InboundWebhook.description: A webhook route the host mounts under the addon+org namespace. On a verified request the kernel webhookin receiver routes the body to 'do'.

path.description: Route mounted under the addon+org namespace (e.g. '/webhooks/github').

verify.description: Signature scheme. Omit for no verification.

secret_ref.description: Signing secret as '<connector>.<credential>' (e.g. 'github.webhook_secret'). Required when verify is set.

do.description: Handler reference the verified body is routed to: 'wasm:<export>' | 'webhook:<key>' | 'compiled:<fn>'.

Billing.description: Marketplace billing surface. metered_events feeds the host billing pipeline.

event.description: Event name (must also be declared in extension_points.events[] when emitted by this addon).

revenue_share.description: Author cut as a 0..1 fraction. The marketplace keeps 1 - revenue_share.

Preset.description: Preset-specific block: which addons to install in which order with which defaults.

requires.description: Keys of other addons in this preset that must install before this one. The preset resolver topologically sorts on this field.

defaults.description: Map of '<addon_key>.<setting_key>' to default value applied at install time.

Theme.description: Theme-specific block. Themes are pure visual contributions.

tokens.description: Bundle-relative path to a JSON file with design tokens.

ConnectorPack.description: ConnectorPack-specific block. Declares third-party API credentials and capability templates.

Signature.description: Detached signature over the canonical JSON of the manifest minus this block.

algorithm.description: Only ed25519 is supported in v3.

key_id.description: Identifier of the public key registered with the marketplace key registry.

Rollup.description: Tier-1 parent-aggregate spec. Either from (a single child column) or expr (a child arithmetic expression) supplies the aggregated value; fn=count ignores both.

target.description: PARENT column the aggregate is written to. Must be a declared column on the model owning the relation.

fn.description: Aggregate function. Defaults to sum. count ignores from/expr.

from.description: A single child column to aggregate. Mutually exclusive with expr.

expr.description: A child arithmetic expression to aggregate. Mutually exclusive with from. Strict arithmetic allowlist only.

Formula.description: Computed column: Tier-2 (default) computes a pure arithmetic expression over the SAME row before every create/update write; Tier-3 delegates the computation to a wasm handler.

target.description: Column this formula writes. Must be a declared column on the owning model.

expr.description: Arithmetic expression (Tier-2). Strict arithmetic allowlist: identifiers resolving to columns, decimal numbers, + - * / and parentheses only. Required unless tier is 3; must be omitted when tier is 3.

tier.description: Compute engine: 2 (default) = arithmetic expression; 3 = wasm handler. Omit for 2.

handler.description: Tier-3 backend, 'wasm:<export>' — an export of the addon's wasm module invoked with the merged row as payload; its returned value is written into target. Required (and only allowed) when tier is 3.

ConfigEntry.description: Where an addon's configuration lives: a declarative model (host renders its CRUD page) or an addon-owned URL. Exactly one of model/url should be set; title is an optional i18n key for the affordance label.

model.description: Declarative model key whose CRUD page is the config surface (host route /m/<model> or equivalent).

url.description: Host-relative or addon:// URL of a custom config screen.

title.description: Optional i18n key for the affordance label; hosts default to a generic 'Configure'.
